benchmark: SIMPLER Local Feature-Inpainting CD (LF-CD) vs Oracle Attention-CD

local_replace.cd_tokens: action dims 0..5, gripper dim 6 keeps clean
local_replace.empty_fallback: no patch>tau or empty ring -> clean action (CD off)
local_replace.operator: v_i <- (1/|R(G)|) Σ_{j∈R(G)} v_j for i∈G, at projector output
local_replace.per_entity: each entity's ring excludes every other entity's target region
local_replace.ring: R(G) = Dilate(G, r) \ G \ all_target; r grows until |R|>=8 (max 4)

oracle.full: G = {i : o_i > tau}, per entity (source/target separated)
oracle.overlap: o_i = |patch_i ∩ M| / |patch_i| in the 224x224 model view

pairing: capture-once-reuse; all 3 arms share the exact initial state/RGB per seed
